name: Infinity Timetable 2.1.1
notes:
What's new in 2.1.1
- Learners list opens read-only, with an Edit pop-up and wider names
- Printing the whole school can be limited to one section
- Department reports have Preview and export (PDF, Excel, Word, image)
- Automatic updates are switched on

Updating keeps all your timetables, settings and your licence.
